text: You're in the woods and a wolf walks up wearing a tiny tie. What do you do?
You wake up and everyone speaks only in rhymes. What do you do?
A genie gives you one wish but it must be about sandwiches. What do you wish for?
You find a door in your house that wasn't there yesterday. What do you do?
You're on a plane and the pilot asks if anyone can fly. What do you do?
Your pet starts talking and demands a raise. What do you say?
You're stuck in an elevator with a mime. What do you do?
You become invisible but only when nobody is looking. What do you do?
You accidentally reply-all to the whole company with a love song. What now?
You're at a wedding and you realise you're at the wrong wedding. What do you do?
A stranger hands you a baby and says 'hold this, I'll be right back'. What do you do?
You win the lottery but must spend it all in 24 hours. What do you do?
You're the only person who can see a giant sea monster in the lake. What do you do?
You wake up as the mayor of a town of raccoons. What's your first law?
